business_summary: 1957 & Co. (Hospitality) Limited, an investment holding company, operates full service restaurants in Hong Kong, Macau, and the People's Republic of China. It also provides catering management and consultancy services. The company operates restaurants under self-owned brands, including An Nam, Modern Shanghai, 10 Shanghai, Modern Shanghai Imperial, Akanoshou, and Hokkaidon; and franchised or sublicensed brands, such as Mango Tree, Gonpachi, and Paper Moon. 1957 & Co. (Hospitality) Limited was incorporated in 2016 and is headquartered in Hong Kong, Hong Kong. 1957 & Co. (Hospitality) Limited is a subsidiary of Real Hero Ventures Limited.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 1957 & Co. Mango Tree, Gonpachi 및 Paper Moon과 같은 프랜차이즈 또는 재라이선스 브랜드도 포함됩니다. 1957 & Co. (Hospitality) Limited는 2016년에 설립되었으며 홍콩 홍콩에 본사를 두고 있습니다. 1957 & Co. (Hospitality) Limited는 Real Hero Ventures Limited의 자회사입니다.
